specs.name: snow_base_straight_v2
specs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied snowy forest background into a reusable EMPTY background plate for a first-person sled game. Preserve its photographic snow texture, cool blue/lavender snow palette, subtle warm peach dusk glow, natural exposure and square aspect. REMOVE EVERY TREE, branch, shrub, tree silhouette, lamp, pole and their cast shadows, even on the horizon. Background consists ONLY of blue evening sky, a very low soft atmospheric snow horizon and continuous snow terrain. No mountains or new landmarks. Horizon at 43 percent image height. Foreground bottom is broad open finely textured snow for a six-dog overlay. A subtle packed snow trail with shallow twin sled tracks leads from bottom center straight toward center horizon. Very low soft snowbanks, no obstacles. No dogs, sled, ropes, UI, text, falling snow particles, blur, watermarks or borders. Trees and lamps will be separate animated game sprites, so the entire base must be free of vegetation and lights. One full-bleed square image, not a collage.

specs.name: turn_left_composite_review_v2
specs.prompt: Use case: compositing. Create one square first-person husky sled game REVIEW COMPOSITE using these EXISTING assets: image 1 is the empty snowy left-turn background to preserve, image 2 is the existing rear-facing husky running sprite sheet, image 3 is the existing tree/lamp/sled cutout sheet. Reuse these visual assets and their exact photographic style and materials; do not introduce new trees, architecture, breeds or objects. Compose EXACTLY SIX huskies in THREE PAIRS running along the trail toward SCREEN LEFT. Nearest pair stays near bottom center, middle pair shifts moderately left, smallest leading pair shifts farther left, forming a believable curved connected team. All dogs face forward into the bend, no looking back. Red harness ropes and blue central sled towline follow the curved team. Place existing frosted birch sprites and warm lamp sprites independently along both sides of the bend, scaling with distance, leaving the road open. Reuse the wooden sled handle along bottom edge. Preserve blue lavender snow, peach dusk and believable perspective; fine restrained powder near paws. Six dogs must remain distinguishable. No HUD, text, coins, obstacles, menus, borders, grid, phone UI. This composite is for reviewing how separate moving layers fit together; the actual base plate remains treeless.
